title: Tracecat 1.1.0-alpha.9
body_markdown:
## Deployment compatibility


For Kubernetes, deploy this prerelease together with Helm chart **0.6.0** . The unified execution backend configuration requires the matching chart; do not upgrade only the application image on an older chart. Remove` tracecat.sandbox.disableNsjail` from saved and supplied values, and select` executor.backend` and` agentExecutor.backend` explicitly (` direct` or` nsjail` ;` ephemeral` is an alias for` nsjail` ).


## Breaking changes


- feat(engine+agents)!: Unify execution backend configuration ([#3656](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3656) )


## Agents


- fix(agents): Normalize Read tool inputs at the LLM proxy ([#3584](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3584) )
- fix(agents): Ignore ping keep-alive stream events ([#3665](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3665) )
- feat(agents): Support child sessions and history forks ([#3604](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3604) )


## Tracecat MCP


- feat(mcp+ui): Auto-layout MCP workflows and compact run_if badges ([#3658](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3658) )


## Integrations


- feat(integrations): Add GitHub App provider for GitHub templates ([#3669](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3669) )


## API


- fix(api): Make default settings initialization race-safe ([#3667](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3667) )


**Full changelog** :[1.1.0-alpha.8.1...1.1.0-alpha.9](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.1.0-alpha.8.1...1.1.0-alpha.9)
